gotchas: Use the eGift Card product (/products/gift-card): its variants report requires_shipping=false, so no shipping-address and no delivery step render, leaving email + card only. Physical hot-sauce variants DO require shipping and pull in the full address form.
eGift variants are tiered by value: 31552620527714 = $10, 31552620560482 = $20, 40534286729314 = $25. The $10 tier is the cheapest no-shipping line item on the store.

Expect the same Shop account verification code documented on onetreeplanted.org: on Shopify, filling an email that already has a Shop account triggers an out-of-band code to the shopper's phone, and skip_shop_pay=true does not prevent it. Not separately re-observed on this host.
Card fields are JS-injected; wait on iframe[name*=card-fields-number] before filling.
notes: US retailer (the Hot Ones hot-sauce shop) on Shopify. Cart route and variant data confirmed over HTTP 2026-08-25; no checkout session was driven here, so unverified.

overrides.addToCart: GET /cart/<variantId>:1 — the permalink redirects straight to /checkouts/cn/<token>/en-us?skip_shop_pay=true, landing directly on the payment page. Confirmed 2026-08-25.
